process_area.title: Lease Product Design, Credit Underwriting & Origination

fields.Participants: Leasing Product Mgr, CFO, B2B Sales (links to VS-11), Category (links to VS-01), Legal, Risk
fields.Trigger: Strategic cycle (links to VS-33); B2B customer demand; partner-bank opportunity

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-renew of "Define product menu" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "approves strategy, capex/funding envelope" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-517 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Product Design, Credit Underwriting & Origination (PA-96.1).)
- operational: conservative LTV, residual discipline, and portfolio diversification
Pain Points / Risks: - **Credit-cycle risk**: Lease portfolio vulnerable to downturn; mitigated by conservative LTV, residual discipline, and portfolio diversification
System Touchpoints: - Strategy/portfolio (links to VS-33); capex (links to VS-40); treasury/funding (links to VS-18)

steps.activity: Leasing Product Mgr/B2B Sales (links to VS-11) assess demand: which customer segments (trade/corporate/government), which asset categories (generators, HVAC, solar — links to VS-70, material handling, scaffolding), typical ticket size (PHP 100K–5M), desired tenor (12–60 months); size addressable portfolio

Define product menu: operating lease (off-balance-sheet for lessee), finance lease (capital lease / lease-to-own), sale-and-leaseback; tenor, advance rental, residual %, end-of-term options (return/renew/buy-out); align to lessor-partner appetite (W3165)
Steering committee approves strategy, capex/funding envelope (links to VS-40/VS-18), risk appetite, 24-month P&L; integrate to VS-33 strategic plan

fields.Participants: Leasing Product Mgr, Finance/Treasury (links to VS-18), Risk, Category (links to VS-01)
fields.Trigger: New product; rate review; cost-of-funds change

workflows.name: Lease Pricing, Residual Setting & Yield Modeling

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "review for Truth in Lending Act disclosure compliance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-517 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Product Design, Credit Underwriting & Origination (PA-96.1).)
- operational: conservative curves and market-data benchmarking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Residual-overstatement risk**: Inflated residuals hide true loss; mitigated by conservative curves and market-data benchmarking
System Touchpoints: - Pricing engine; treasury/funding (links to VS-18); residual master; tax (links to VS-79)

steps.activity: Treasury (links to VS-18) provide cost-of-funds (funding spread over benchmark); Finance build lease-pricing model: monthly rental from asset cost, tenor, advance rental, residual value, cost-of-funds, operating cost, target margin, tax (VAT/EWT — W3183)

Risk/Category (links to VS-01/VS-35) set residual values per asset category: depreciation curve, secondary-market value (used-equipment market — links to W3179), remarketing cost, end-of-lease condition standards; benchmark to industry data
Leasing Product Mgr publish rate card and approval matrix; configure pricing engine with margin floor and approval tiers; Legal/Compliance review for Truth in Lending Act disclosure compliance

fields.Participants: Lease Credit Mgr, Credit Analyst, B2B Sales (links to VS-11), Trade Credit (links to VS-68), Legal

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-submit of "submits lease application" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-assign of "assign internal rating" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "record decision and conditions" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: risk-based pricing (margin tier by internal rating)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Credit-mis-pricing risk**: Under-pricing risk leads to losses; mitigated by risk-based pricing (margin tier by internal rating)
System Touchpoints: - Credit scoring; KYB/sanctions (links to VS-86); AR/credit exposure (links to VS-16/VS-68)

steps.activity: B2B Sales (links to VS-11) submits lease application: customer KYB (links to VS-86), financial statements, trade references, existing exposure (links to VS-68 credit), asset & tenor requested, intended use

Credit Analyst underwrite: credit-scoring model (financial ratios, payment history with BuildRight — links to VS-16 AR, industry risk, project/contract backing), exposure aggregation vs. limit, sanctions/PEP screening (links to VS-86); assign internal rating

Lease Credit Manager approves per authority matrix (small-ticket automated; large-ticket committee with CFO/Risk); communicate decision to Sales; on decline, provide reasons and remediation path; record decision and conditions

fields.Participants: Lease Origination Mgr, B2B Sales (links to VS-11), Legal, Finance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "generate lease quote" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-escalate of "escalate to Lease Product Mgr/Credit Mgr" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "Legal/Lease Origination generate lease contract from approved template" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-517 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Product Design, Credit Underwriting & Origination (PA-96.1).)
- operational: template-based generation and legal review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Contract-error risk**: Mis-drafted contract creates legal/credit exposure; mitigated by template-based generation and legal review
System Touchpoints: - Pricing engine; contract template/CMS (links to VS-22/VS-30); digital signature (links to VS-30)

steps.activity: Lease Origination Mgr generate lease quote: asset spec, price, tenor, advance rental, monthly rental, residual, end-of-term options, fees, taxes (VAT/EWT — W3183), insurance, total cost of lease; Truth-in-Lending disclosure (effective interest rate)
B2B Sales (links to VS-11) present quote and negotiate terms within authority; for off-matrix deals, escalate to Lease Product Mgr/Credit Mgr; capture customer acceptance

Legal/Lease Origination generate lease contract from approved template: parties, asset description, tenor, rentals, residual, insurance/maintenance obligations, default/cure, early-termination, end-of-term options, jurisdiction; obtain signatures (digital — links to VS-30)

fields.Participants: Lease Origination Mgr, Treasury (links to VS-18), Legal, Finance
fields.Trigger: New partnership; funding-source review; portfolio rebalance
fields.Volume: ~3–8 lessor partners (banks, leasing companies, OEM captive)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "document BuildRight's role" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "monitor partner performance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-517 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Product Design, Credit Underwriting & Origination (PA-96.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Funding-concentration risk**: Single lessor dominates; mitigated by partner diversification
System Touchpoints: - Partner master (links to VS-29); treasury/funding (links to VS-18); lease booking (links to W3169)

steps.activity: Treasury/Lease Origination (links to VS-18) maintain lessor-partner relationships: bank leasing subsidiaries, standalone leasing companies, OEM-captive finance; negotiate master agreement, funding spread, recourse (with/without recourse), approval criteria, SLA
Per deal: route to appropriate lessor per asset category, ticket size, customer rating; obtain funding approval; document BuildRight's role (originator/servicer/broker); book accordingly (W3169)

Finance/Treasury monitor partner performance: approval rate, funding speed, default recovery, repricing events; diversify funding to avoid concentration; manage BuildRight's warehouse line / funding facility

fields.Participants: Lease Origination Mgr, B2B Sales (links to VS-11), Finance, Customer
fields.Trigger: Customer decision moment; sales enablement cycle

workflows.name: Lease vs Buy vs Rent Decision Support & Sales Enablement

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Lease Origination Mgr provide decision tool to Sales" (replaces manual Step 1).
Controls: - CTL-517 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Product Design, Credit Underwriting & Origination (PA-96.1).)
- operational: objective TCO tool and needs-based selling
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mis-selling risk**: Recommending lease where buy is better damages trust; mitigated by objective TCO tool and needs-based selling
System Touchpoints: - Decision calculator; CRM/opportunity (links to VS-11/VS-13); pricing (links to W3162)

steps.activity: Lease Origination Mgr provide decision tool to Sales (links to VS-11): compare lease vs. buy vs. rent (links to VS-12) on total-cost-of-ownership, cash-flow, tax treatment (deductibility of rentals vs. depreciation — W3183), balance-sheet impact, technology refresh

B2B Sales position lease value proposition: conserve cash, predictable payments, bundled maintenance, end-of-term flexibility, fast approval; tailor to customer segment (trade vs. corporate vs. government — links to VS-46)
Sales/Finance run win/loss analysis: why customers chose/declined lease; refine product/pricing/process; feed into product strategy (W3161)

fields.Participants: Lease Origination Mgr, Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), Category (links to VS-01), Vendor, Receiving (links to VS-04)
fields.Trigger: Lease signed; asset to be procured

workflows.name: Asset Specification, Vendor Selection & Procurement for Lease

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "capture serial/asset-tag plan" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "record and photos" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-517 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Product Design, Credit Underwriting & Origination (PA-96.1).)
- operational: serial capture and acceptance sign-off
Pain Points / Risks: - **Asset-mismatch risk**: Delivered asset doesn't match lease contract; mitigated by serial capture and acceptance sign-off
System Touchpoints: - Item/asset master (links to VS-29/VS-35); PO (links to VS-03); receiving (links to VS-04)

steps.activity: Lease Origination Mgr/Category (links to VS-01) finalize asset spec: brand, model, configuration, warranty, accessories; confirm vendor (BuildRight inventory if stocked, or vendor direct — links to VS-03); capture serial/asset-tag plan

Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34) place purchase order to vendor; negotiate BuildRight's purchase price (separate from lease price to customer — margin capture); arrange delivery to customer site or BuildRight DC for inspection

Receiving (links to VS-04) / Field verify asset delivery, condition, serial number, warranty commencement; capture asset record and photos; deliver/install to customer; obtain customer acceptance (links to W3168 perfection)

fields.Participants: Lease Origination Mgr, Legal, Insurance (links to VS-26), Finance, Customer

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "verify customer-maintained coverage where applicable" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "record, customer acceptance, funding confirmation" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-517 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Product Design, Credit Underwriting & Origination (PA-96.1).)
- operational: mandatory perfection checklist; operational: perfection checklist
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unperfected-security risk**: Loss of priority in customer insolvency; mitigated by mandatory perfection checklist
System Touchpoints: - Contract/security filing (links to VS-22/VS-36); insurance (links to VS-26); lease booking (links to W3169)

steps.activity: Legal perfect lease: contract execution; security agreement / chattel mortgage registration with the Registry of Deeds (Act 1508) / notation under the RA 11057 personal-property security registry, where applicable; lien on asset
Insurance (links to VS-26) bind required coverage: property damage, theft, casualty, third-party liability; confirm lessor as loss-payee; verify customer-maintained coverage where applicable

Lease Origination Mgr complete booking package: signed contract, perfect security interest, insurance certificate, asset record, customer acceptance, funding confirmation; book lease (links to W3169) and disburse to vendor
